protocol.independence: Authored without method tests, earlier fixture content, synthetic_dev examples or real holdout key. Freeze before graph-native method output.
protocol.splits: Six development shapes and six new validation compositions; case families do not cross splits.
protocol.oracle: Exhaustively enumerate small injective node mappings; compare normalized node labels and directed edge multiset capacities. Oracle has no dependency on method implementation.
protocol.semantic_identity: Literal full graph isomorphism, including node and edge cardinality.
protocol.template_containment: Literal typed directed non-induced subgraph injection, preserving multiplicity and qualifiers.
protocol.structural_analogy: Containment after explicit many-to-one lexical abstraction, with consistent bijective original lexical renaming per label-kind/symbol-kind/identity-namespace channel; type, role, qualifiers, scope and direction retained.
protocol.provenance: IDs and claim_ids identify source records but are not matching labels. Independent support requires distinct source nodes, not repeated edges.
protocol.unknown: Unrepresented/malformed input is evaluated separately from no-match; exhaustion is unknown.
